Growth & demand: India is the largest provider of generic medicines globally with a share of approximately 20% in global supply by volume, contributes around 60% of global vaccines, supplies over 50% of Africa's requirement for generics, ~40% of generic demand in the US, and ~25% of all medicine in the UK.
